description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 4720015138915 HOSE ASSEMBLY,NONME: Line 0001 Qty 19 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0069 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
